description: STEP 1 of the screen-recording flow, for an account whose statistics do not come from a platform connection. Opens the session and returns `session.challengeCode`. Show that code to the user and ask them to record their statistics screen WITH THE CODE VISIBLE, then upload it with vibevo_upload_social_account_stats. Calling this again before the recording is submitted returns the SAME session and code, so it is safe to re-read. Refused with SOCIAL_CONNECT_ACTIVE when the account already gets statistics automatically. Requires the write scope + PUBLIC_API_WRITE.
name: vibevo_start_social_account_stats_session
title: Start a screen-recording session (creator)
